name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana
description: Universal health insurance scheme of the Government of Maharashtra providing cashless secondary and tertiary medical and surgical hospitalization care to all families residing in Maharashtra.
department: State Health Assurance Society, Public Health Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: All families holding a valid Maharashtra Ration Card and Aadhaar Card residing in Maharashtra
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year across 1,356 medical and surgical procedures in empaneled network hospitals throughout Maharashtra.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the State Health Assurance Society (SHAS), Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra.
Universal health insurance scheme operational across all districts of Maharashtra in both public and private empaneled hospitals.
Universal coverage for all ration card holder families in Maharashtra (Yellow, Orange, and White ration cards).
Annual health cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family on family floater basis covering diagnostic, surgical, and therapeutic procedures.
Official State Health Assurance Society portal hosted at jeevandayee.gov.in.
Integrated with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY in co-branded mode providing comprehensive health security across over 1,000 network hospitals.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Treatment must be taken in an empaneled network hospital under pre-authorization by Arogyamitra.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI identity proof of patient and family head.

required_documents.title: Maharashtra Ration Card
required_documents.description: Valid Yellow, Orange, or White Ration card issued by Food and Civil Supplies Department.
required_documents.issuing_authority: Food and Civil Supplies Department, Maharashtra
